operator: Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas (MoPNG) with Oil Marketing Companies IOCL, BPCL, HPCL

purpose.en: Pan-India 24x7 multilingual helpline for attending emergency LPG leakage complaints, with mechanic and field support.
purpose.hi: एलपीजी गैस रिसाव की आपात शिकायतों के लिए राष्ट्रीय 24x7 बहुभाषी हेल्पलाइन, मैकेनिक और फील्ड सहायता के साथ।

evidence: Emergency Helpline No. 1906 ... This multilingual LPG Emergency Helpline was dedicated to the nation on 1.1.2016 ... This facility is available 24*7 operations with 2 shifts 12 hours each for attending emergency LPG leakage complaints.
